name: mobility-toolbox-js
description: Toolbox for JavaScript applications in the domains of mobility and logistics.

scripts.build:tsc: rm -rf build && pnpm tsc && cp package.json build/ && cp README.md build/ && cp LICENSE build/  && cp -R src/types build/ && find build -type f -name '*.test.*' -delete
scripts.cy:test:chrome: pnpm build && start-server-and-test start http://localhost:3000 'cypress run --browser chrome'
scripts.cy:test:edge: pnpm build && start-server-and-test start http://localhost:3000 'cypress run --browser edge'
scripts.cy:test:firefox: pnpm build && start-server-and-test start http://localhost:3000 'cypress run --browser firefox'
scripts.doc: pnpm build && pnpm apidoc && cd doc && rm -rf node_modules/mobility-toolbox-js && pnpm install --force && pnpm build
scripts.doc:dev: pnpm clean && pnpm build && pnpm apidoc && pnpm doc:dev:examples
scripts.doc:dev:examples: pnpm clean && pnpm build && cd doc && rm -rf node_modules/mobility-toolbox-js && pnpm install --force && pnpm dev
scripts.esbuild:all: esbuild src/index.js src/**/*.js src/**/*.ts src/**/**/*.js src/**/**/*.ts --target=chrome100 --outdir=build/ --loader:.js=jsx
scripts.format: prettier --write 'src/**/*.js' 'src/**/*.ts'  'src/**/*.test.js' && eslint src/**/*.js src/**/*.test.js src/**/*.ts --fix && stylelint 'src/**/*.css' 'src/**/*.scss' --fix --allow-empty-input
scripts.lint: eslint src/**/*.js src/**/*.ts && stylelint src/**/*.css src/**/*.scss --allow-empty-input
scripts.publish:beta: HUSKY=0 pnpm release --prerelease beta --skip.changelog  && pnpm build && cd build && HUSKY=0 pnpm publish --tag beta --no-git-checks && git push origin HEAD && git push --tags
scripts.publish:public: pnpm release  && pnpm run build && cd build && HUSKY=0 pnpm publish --no-git-checks && git push origin HEAD && git push --tags
scripts.start: pnpm doc && cd doc && pnpm start
scripts.start:examples: cd doc && pnpm build && pnpm start
scripts.types:backend: pnpm types:stops && pnpm types:routing && pnpm types:moco && pnpm types:realtime && pnpm format
scripts.types:realtime:asyncapi: asyncapi generate models typescript https://backend.developer.dev.geops.io/tralis-docs/asyncapi.json --output src/types/realtime/asyncapi --tsModelType=interface --tsRawPropertyNames --tsEnumType=enum && node -e "require('./scripts/generate-asyncapi-index.js')" && eslint --fix src/types/realtime/asyncapi/*.ts
